Fast Walsh-Hadamard based Pi generation for Reed-Solomon erasure recovery.

# Purpose
This C file implements private helper functions for Reed-Solomon erasure processing. Its main task is to generate the `Pi` polynomial values used by the erasure-recovery algorithm for block sizes `16`, `32`, `64`, `128`, and `256`. The code follows the method described in the comments: it builds a mask from the erased positions, applies the Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform, combines the result with precomputed twiddle tables, reduces values modulo `255`, and converts the final logarithm-domain values back into field elements. The file is part of the internal Reed-Solomon implementation and is not a public API file.

The file contains several execution paths selected at compile time. When AVX support is enabled, it uses SIMD vector types and macros to perform the transforms and field operations in parallel. It also supports two internal representations for the `Pi` computation, controlled by `FD_REEDSOL_PI_USE_SHORT`. When AVX is not available, it falls back to a generic scalar implementation in [`gen_pi_noavx_generic`](<#gen_pi_noavx_generic>). The file also defines precomputed `fwht_l_twiddle_*` tables and helper functions such as [`compact_ws`](<#compact_ws>), [`exp_76`](<#exp_76>), [`exp_29`](<#exp_29>), [`exp_16`](<#exp_16>), [`exp_4`](<#exp_4>), and [`exp_2`](<#exp_2>), which support the transform and exponentiation steps needed to build the output polynomial values.
